stories.headline: NQP Graduate Guarantee petition passes 10,000
stories.body: A petition to extend the NHS Graduate Guarantee to newly qualified paramedics has passed 10,000 signatures, so the Government will now have to respond. It needs 100,000 to be considered for a debate in Parliament.
stories.why: Job security for NQPs affects every crew, from students now to the colleagues they will join.

stories.headline: Wrexham ambulance handovers average two and a half hours
stories.body: Handovers at Wrexham Maelor are far over Wales's 45-minute target. The Welsh Ambulance Service is using 'call before convey' and advanced paramedic practitioners treating people at home to keep ambulances on the road.
stories.why: Long handovers keep crews off the road, so alternatives to conveyance matter more than ever.

stories.headline: LAS shares recordings of sexual harassment of call staff
stories.body: London Ambulance Service released anonymised call extracts showing the abuse its control-room staff face. About a third of its 462 reported sexual abuse incidents were aimed at 999 and 111 colleagues.
stories.why: Abuse of control-room colleagues is abuse of the whole team, and it should always be reported.

stories.headline: NI Health Minister backs See and Treat and Hear and Treat
stories.body: On a visit to NIAS, Health Minister Robbie Butler highlighted that 44,064 incidents were resolved by See and Treat and 19,612 by Hear and Treat in 2025-26, keeping patients out of busy EDs.
stories.why: Care closer to home is now a core part of the job, not an add-on.

stories.headline: Heart stopped seven times: Kent man meets his team
stories.body: A 59-year-old man went into cardiac arrest seven times at home. Call handlers, a CFR, paramedics, AAPs and a critical care paramedic achieved sustained ROSC after nearly two hours, and he has now met the team.
stories.why: A powerful reminder that every link in the chain of survival counts.
